traps: Round foramen = maxillary NERVE into the alar canal; caudal alar foramen = maxillary ARTERY in. Oval foramen = mandibular nerve (+ middle meningeal artery).
Cochlear window (membrane-closed) vs vestibular window (stapes footplate).
Mandibular FOSSA (temporal bone) receives the CONDYLAR process; masseteric FOSSA (ramus) receives the masseter.
Lingual surface = mandibular teeth; palatine surface = maxillary teeth. Mesial = toward the first incisor; distal = away.
Upper fourth premolar = superior shearing tooth (3 roots). Molars: 2 upper, 3 lower per side.
Hyoid order, skull → tongue: tympanohyoid (cartilage) → stylohyoid → epihyoid → ceratohyoid → basihyoid (unpaired) · thyrohyoid toward the thyroid cartilage.
Interalveolar septa = between teeth; interradicular septa = between roots of ONE tooth.
Rostral alar foramen (pterygopalatine fossa) ≠ caudal alar foramen (maxillary artery in) ≠ round foramen (maxillary nerve in).
Maxillary foramen = CAUDAL opening of the infraorbital canal; infraorbital foramen = ROSTRAL opening.
